narrative.overview: The landing page reads like an institution's prospectus that happens to be full of real student work. Photography of the studio, the mentors and the students carries the page; the structure makes it feel like an academy rather than a salon brochure. A white ground keeps it calm, and plum frames it.
keyCharacteristics: White ground with faint plum-tinted bands for rhythm.
Plum owns the frame and actions; cream appears only as a small accent.
One modern sans, moderate headings, short copy.
Rounded photo crops from the academy's own studio photographs.

rules.name: The Cream Is A Garnish Rule
rules.body: Cream marks small things (a badge, a chip, an icon disc). If it covers a region, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Plum Frames, White Breathes Rule
rules.body: Plum is for the frame and for actions; the content ground stays white.

rules.name: The Quiet Headline Rule
rules.body: Headings stay at moderate sizes; the photographs lead.

dos: Use the academy's real studio photographs for imagery.
Keep copy short and let a photograph or icon carry the point.
Take name, phone, email, address and social links from the app config only.
donts: Don't cover a region in cream or let it replace the white ground.
Don't use shadows, gradients or glass.
Don't add a kicker or eyebrow above a heading.
